notes: Sourced from Mackie's official product page (mackie.com) and the official HM Series Headphone Amplifiers Owner's Manual PDF (linked from that page: https://mackie.com/img/file_resources/HM%20Series%20Headphone%20Amplifiers_OM.pdf, Part No. SWI227 Rev. B, ©2025 LOUD Audio). 19" 1U rackmount 4-channel headphone amp with 12 total headphone outputs (4 front, 1 per channel; 8 rear, 2 per channel — all 1/4" TRS). Rear Main In L/R and Main Out L/R are combo XLR3/TRS jacks (choose one connector type, not both at once); Main In XLR is female, Main Out XLR is male. Front panel also has one extra 1/4" main input jack per the manual's body text (pages 5 and 9), though it is not one of the manual's explicitly numbered front-panel callouts — flagged here as a minor ambiguity. Aux inputs are 1 per channel (front panel only), 1/4", spec'd as unbalanced. No graded connectors present (pure analog audio + power), so no "grade" fields were set. Sibling products in the same family: HM-4 (4 headphone outs, no aux, 1/4" TS main I/O only) and HM-800 (8-channel, 16 headphone outs, dual main ins/outs, no XLR — 1/4" only).

ports.name: Main In L
ports.note: Rear panel; combo jack — balanced XLR3 (female) or balanced/unbalanced 1/4" TRS. Use one or the other, not both simultaneously.

ports.name: Main In R
ports.note: Rear panel; combo jack — balanced XLR3 (female) or balanced/unbalanced 1/4" TRS.

ports.name: Main In (Front Panel)
ports.note: Additional 1/4" main input jack on far-left of front panel, per Owner's Manual text (not a separately numbered front-panel callout in the manual's diagram).

ports.name: Main Out L
ports.note: Rear panel; combo jack — balanced XLR3 (male, for sending to another unit) or balanced/unbalanced 1/4" TRS.

ports.name: Main Out R
ports.note: Rear panel; combo jack — balanced XLR3 (male) or balanced/unbalanced 1/4" TRS.

ports.name: Aux In 1
ports.note: Front panel, channel 1. Spec sheet lists Aux Input Impedance as unbalanced; jack carries stereo aux-send signal blended with Main via the channel Balance knob.

ports.name: Headphone Out 1 (Front)
ports.note: Front panel, channel 1. Tip=Left, Ring=Right, Sleeve=common ground.

ports.name: Headphone Out 1 (Rear A)
ports.note: Rear panel; two jacks per channel (parallel), channel 1.

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: 3-pin IEC power inlet, 10A. Rear-panel voltage-selector switch for 100-120V or 220-240V, 50/60Hz, 24W.
